description: Upload an ad image from a public URL or a local file. Returns image hash for use in ad creatives. Note: fetching from a URL requires the app to have Meta's URL-fetch capability — if that fails with an OAuthException 'Application does not have the capability to make this API call', use file_path to upload the raw bytes instead, which does not require that capability.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to upload into (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

file_path.description: Local filesystem path of the image to upload. Sent as base64-encoded bytes, bypassing Meta's URL-fetch capability requirement.

name.description: Name to assign to the uploaded image. Defaults to the file_path basename when uploading a local file.

url.description: Public URL of the image to upload

name: upload_image
